summary.story: Dahufa (simplified Chinese: 大护法; traditional Chinese: 大護法; pinyin: Dàhùfǎ) is a 2017 Chinese animated fantasy film. The film is directed by Bu Sifan and produced by Angie Lam. It stars voice cast of Xiao Liansha, Feng Sheng, King Shih-Chieh, and Zhang Youwu.
summary.summary: Dahufa (simplified Chinese: 大护法; traditional Chinese: 大護法; pinyin: Dàhùfǎ) is a 2017 Chinese animated fantasy film. The film is directed by Bu Sifan and produced by Angie Lam. It stars voice cast of Xiao Liansha, Feng Sheng, King Shih-Chieh, and Zhang Youwu. It was the first film in China that was self-rated (Chinese: 自主分级) PG-13 by the film's producers.
